job: Two drives have failed in the data hall: one high up in row A at U40 and one low down in row B at U10. Pull both sled caddies and bring the last one out to the staging bench outside the hall.
understood_as: Pull the failed hot-swap drive sleds from bay U40 in row A and bay U10 in row B of the data hall, and take the second one out to the staging bench outside the hall.
steps: Go to row A and pull the drive sled out of bay U40.
Go to row B and pull the drive sled out of bay U10.
Carry that last sled out of the hall towards the staging bench.

demos.why: Shows how a hand releases the sled latch and draws the drive straight out of the bay without catching it.
Shows how firmly to hold the sled handle so the drive does not slip out or get bent while being pulled and carried.

questions: What should happen to the first drive sled, from row A at U40, once it is pulled: should it stay on top of the rack, be set down somewhere in the hall, or also go out to the staging bench?
The staging bench outside the hall has not been located in the building scan; could you have it added as a location so the robot can put the drive down on it?
unmet: Placing the last drive sled on the staging bench itself: the robot can only bring it out of the hall to the way out, not set it on the bench, because the bench has not been located yet.
No plan for where the first drive sled (row A, U40) ends up after it is pulled.
